citations.title: Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics: QA Roles in Medical Equipment Manufacturing (NAICS 339100)
citations.what_it_says: Documents wage distributions for QA/QC roles in medical-device manufacturing, with median wages above general clinical therapist medians and senior roles reaching six figures.

citations.title: ISO 13485:2016 — Medical devices — Quality management systems — Requirements for regulatory purposes
citations.what_it_says: ISO 13485:2016 is the international standard itself, published by the International Organization for Standardization, which normatively defines the medical device QMS scope and requirements that third-party training certificates attest to; cited as the underlying normative document rather than as independent evidence of training program quality.

citations.title: Workforce trends in regulatory affairs and quality assurance for medical devices
citations.journal: RAPS Compensation & Scope of Practice Report
citations.what_it_says: Reports that 13485 auditor training and RAC credentials are the two most-cited qualifications in MedTech QA/RA postings and correlate with mid-five-figure compensation premiums at the specialist level.

citations.title: Medical Devices; Quality System Regulation Amendments (QMSR Final Rule harmonizing 21 CFR 820 with ISO 13485)
citations.what_it_says: Finalizes alignment of 21 CFR 820 with ISO 13485, increasing the practical value of 13485 training for U.S. MedTech QA roles through the 2026 effective date and beyond.
